body: People increasingly reason with large language models (LLMs), yet complementary capabilities do not guarantee outperforming both components. In a between-subjects study, participants (N=535) solved a 40-item battery of matrix reasoning, mental rotation, syllogisms, and letter-string analogies, unaided or with GPT-5.6-Luna, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.6 Flash, or Kimi K3. Each assisted trial required consultation with the model. Each model answered every item alone 100 times under matched elicitation. The assisted-unaided accuracy difference increased with item-level LLM competence. Deference varied across tasks and increased with competence within tasks. Post-advice confidence distinguished correct from incorrect answers less strongly than unaided confidence. In a reference comparison, about half the increase in LLM accuracy carried through to assisted accuracy. How much of that accuracy gain reached participants differed across the models. These findings motivate evaluating LLMs in interaction with humans and designing support for selective deference that preserves independent reasoning.
summaryZh: 本研究通过对 535 名参与者进行大规模实证研究，深入探讨了人类与大语言模型（LLM）在矩阵推理、逻辑推演等任务中的协同效应。研究发现，尽管 LLM 具备辅助能力，但人类对模型的依赖程度（Deference）与任务难度及模型能力高度相关。实验表明，仅约一半的 LLM 准确率提升转化为人类的实际表现增益，且人类在获得建议后的自信度区分度较差。这些发现强调了在人机协作中设计选择性依赖机制的重要性，以确保人类能够保留独立推理能力，从而实现真正的协同增效。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究通过大规模实证分析揭示了人类与大模型协作中的协同效应与局限，为设计更有效的辅助决策系统提供了重要依据。

glossary.explanationZh: 人类与人工智能系统协作时产生的整体效能大于各部分之和的现象。
指人类在协作中根据任务特征和模型能力，有选择性地采纳或拒绝模型建议的行为。
一种评估逻辑推理和模式识别能力的心理测量任务。
